description.default: Translate the built-in browser's current page into Chinese. The plugin hands the task to the current AI session, which drives the browser itself.
description.zh-CN: 把内置浏览器当前页面翻译成中文。插件把任务派给当前工作区的 AI 会话，由 AI 用自己的浏览器工具取节点、翻译、回填。

modelAccess.purpose: 把网页文本分段送去翻译，译文回填到页面节点。

description.default: Translate the current page of the built-in browser in place. action: install (put the button and wait for a click), translate (translate immediately), restore (back to the original text), status (read-only state), ping (lightweight page check).
description.zh-CN: 把内置浏览器当前页面就地翻译。action：install（装上按钮并等用户点击）、translate（立刻翻译）、restore（还原原文）、status（只读状态）、ping（轻量探测）。
